Tool: Matterport Supports Services: Service 1 / CGI 3d virtual property tours Category: 3D Digital Twin Platform Primary Use: Creates professional-grade 3D "digital twins" of physical spaces using LiDAR scanning. Notes: Millimeter-level accuracy; Enterprise plans cost approx. $1,300/mo.
Tool: Enviz Supports Services: Service 1 / CGI 3d virtual property tours Category: VR/CGI Visualization Primary Use: Converts 2D floorplans into immersive, true-to-scale 3D virtual environments for walkthroughs. Why It Matters (2026): Accelerates off-plan sales by increasing buyer confidence through realistic visualizations of unbuilt spaces. Notes: Virtual experience hosting starts at $3/month; includes 30-day free trial.
